payload.name: Staged scarcity design
payload.fact: Staged scarcity design creates an anxiety premium through dynamic supply control, associated with an anticipated deficit effect.

provenance.title: Neuropsychological Mechanisms in K-Pop Consumer Engagement: A Tripartite Analysis of Scarcity Tactics, Random Reward and Cultural Mixture
provenance.quote_or_locus: Staged scarcity design, like the three-phase release of BLACKPINK's albums, creates an anxiety premium through dynamic supply control, which triggers the prefrontal cortex's (DLPFC) anticipated deficit effect

decision_note: NOT_TRANSFERABLE — narrow to K-pop marketing techniques, and its mechanism ('anxiety premium', 'anticipated deficit effect') is speculative rather than an established, transferable behavioral finding.
